title: trashcans-skyblock-pack
description: Hypixel Skyblock modpack for modern versions
body:
# Trashcan's Skyblock Pack
Contains basic performance mods a few qol mods and popular hypixel skyblock mods replicting most features from 1.8.9 mods

# Skyblock Mods Included
- [https://modrinth.com/mod/skyblocker-liap](https://modrinth.com/mod/skyblocker-liap)
- [https://modrinth.com/mod/sbt](https://modrinth.com/mod/sbt)
- [https://modrinth.com/mod/skycubed](https://modrinth.com/mod/skycubed)
- [https://modrinth.com/mod/firmament](https://modrinth.com/mod/firmament)
- [https://modrinth.com/mod/skylens](https://modrinth.com/mod/skylens)
- [https://modrinth.com/mod/skyocean](https://modrinth.com/mod/skyocean)
- [https://modrinth.com/mod/skyblock-profile-viewer](https://modrinth.com/mod/skyblock-profile-viewer)


# Important Notes
Icon made by Mqisty

Recommended custom java arguments: `-XX:+UseZGC -XX:+ZGenerational` may or may not improve performance for you. I recommend 4gb of memory or more allocated to the pack

Report any issues on the [github](https://github.com/CyclopsBot/trashcan_skyblock_pack/issues/new)
